endorsements.name: Michal Skowron
endorsements.label: CVE-2022-26330
endorsements.description: Potential vulnerabilities have been identified in Micro Focus ArcSight Logger. The vulnerabilities could be remotely exploited resulting in Information Disclosure, or Self Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects: Micro Focus ArcSight Logger versions prior to v7.2.2 version and prior versions.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.5)
